record.question: Who has been elected as the President of Sri Lanka in the 2010 elections?
record.explanation: Answer A: Mahinda Rajapaksa. Mahinda Rajapaksa won the January 2010 Sri Lankan presidential election. The Commonwealth election observers' original report records 6,015,934 votes (57.88%) for Rajapaksa against 4,173,185 (40.15%) for Sarath Fonseka. Reference: https://aceproject.org/ero-en/regions/asia/LK/sri-lanka-final-report-presidential-elections-1; https://elections.gov.lk/web/wp-content/uploads/pdf/admin_reports/AR2015_E.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
